name: RSS Ticker
description: Headlines from the feeds you choose, rotating on the bar, the full list one click away

feeds.description: Feed addresses (RSS 2.0, Atom or RSS 1.0/RDF), one per entry; the flyout adds and removes them too

refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between feed updates; 5 is the minimum

tileItems.description: How many of the newest headlines rotate on the bar tile

maxPerFeed.description: How many items to keep per feed
